QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Slow and Steady
QuestInfo.0: Eremos and Surana are overjoyed to be guides for your first adventure aboard the Eluna Express!
QuestInfo.1: Eremos recommends Ellinel Fairy Academy as the place to begin your training. Thankfully, the Eluna Express possesses amazing Ryuul technology to teleport its passengers to any destination. Whenever you have travel troubles, you can rely on the Eluna Express to teleport you wherever your heart desires!
QuestInfo.2: As Eremose and Surana requested, you traveled to Ellinel Fairy Academy and defeated the troublesome monsters there.

default.0: You haven't completed your training in Ellinel yet. You should defeat 500 monsters around Ellinel.
